articles.summary: Gentex Corporation is celebrating the fifth anniversary of its Spanish-speaking assembly lines, or Limited English Proficiency (LEP) Program. The milestone reflects the company's commitment to removing barriers to employment, creating opportunities for Spanish-speaking employees, and strengthening its workforce.
articles.title: Gentex’s Spanish-Speaking Manufacturing Program Celebrates 5 Years

articles.summary: In 2016, Gentex improved on reflections with a camera-based, unobstructed digital view of the road behind the vehicle, integrated into the rearview mirror already familiar to drivers. Now, with NextGen FDM, the digital rear vision experience takes another major step forward.
articles.title: NextGen FDM: Intuitive Innovation in Digital Rear Vision

articles.summary: Gentex Corporation announced today that its innovative Dimmable Sun Visor has been selected as a finalist for the 2026 Automotive News PACE Awards.
articles.title: Gentex Dimmable Sun Visor Named Finalist for 2026 Automotive News PACE Award
